factor_name: Multi-horizon rank persistence with sign agreement

calculation.description: Average cross-sectional percentile ranks of 20-day and 60-day returns, discounted when the two horizons disagree. Computed using prices available at the signal date and evaluated against subsequent 20-trading-day returns.

validation.regime_notes: 20-day predictive IC passed the benchmark gates, with conservative interpretation due to the 15-asset universe and 310 valid dates. Annual 20-day breakdown was not separately computed; 10-day IC was positive in 2021-26 except weak 2020, with especially strong 2026 contribution. The 5-day evaluation had no valid observations because of source-date alignment and is not used for admission.
validation.provenance: No-lookahead: factor uses return windows ending at signal date; forward return begins after signal date; prices cut at 2026-07-15. Deterministic library correlation audit remains required.
